entries.0eb3f5000f586529: Under the “Medium-Term Management Plan R2028,” with fiscal 2028 as its final year, the company has set four medium-term management policies: “Gaining customer satisfaction and trust,” “Creating value through original ideas,” “Strengthening profitability and cash-generating capacity through structural reform,” and “Establishing and strengthening a sustainable management foundation.” In addition to expanding sales to the medical and healthcare market and IoT devices, which it lists as focus markets, the company has obtained IATF16949 certification, the automotive industry quality management system standard essential for gaining sales channels in the mobility market, and has begun full-scale sales activities. For the next-generation infrastructure market, such as data centers, the company has developed the high-frequency, low-jitter crystal oscillator “KCRO-05” and is proceeding with sample shipments and building a mass production system.

entries.15f53ead81936fcf: The Business Overview section states that the company mainly handles research and development and sales, that manufacturing is mainly performed by consolidated subsidiaries, and that it has built a structure for integrated operations from research and development through manufacturing and sales. entries.51e0e239f64c5b6b: The company’s strength is a structure in which the company handles research and development and sales, while its consolidated subsidiaries handle manufacturing, allowing the group to carry out everything from research and development through manufacturing and sales in an integrated way. In addition to its main product, the tuning-fork crystal resonator, the company is advancing product development in the next-generation high-speed communications field, including the “KCRO-05,” a high-frequency (625MHz) crystal oscillator with extremely low phase jitter aimed at optical transceiver applications for AI data centers.
entries.5390d9793d199e99: Revenue is concentrated in crystal products, and the company has a high dependence on specific customers. The crystal products business accounts for more than 99% of consolidated revenue, and sales to Taiwan Crystal Technology Co., Ltd., a major customer, accounted for 43.1% of revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026. Revenue by region was ¥2,568 million for Taiwan, ¥996 million for China, ¥652 million for Japan and ¥644 million for the United States.
entries.6de321170c72ba48: The net loss attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12 million, narrowed from a loss of ¥79 million in the previous fiscal year. Deterioration in product mix, higher raw material costs and higher costs such as personnel expenses were not fully offset by higher revenue, but a recovery in orders for the main products significantly narrowed the loss.
entries.76134076ebce6e82: Its predecessor, Fuji Sangyo Gomei Kaisha, was founded in 1949 in Nirasaki, Yamanashi Prefecture, and the company was established as a joint-stock company in 1951.
